QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Castle] Pure Fan Love
QuestInfo.0: Listen to Anne Nah, who was thoroughly disappointed in not being able to make Princess Violetta smile.
QuestInfo.1:
Anne Nah is the 13th president of Princess Violetta's fan club. She failed at making her smile but wants to make more memories before she leaves. She asked you to take pictures of things that remind her of the princess. 

#rTIP: Double-click the #t2432656# to activate photo mode. Move the mouse to find Violetta's symbols and click to take a photo.
QuestInfo.2: You got photos to remind Anne Nah of Violetta. Even just taking photos of the princess's things makes you a bit nauseous.
QuestInfo.placeSummary: #m106030000# - Violetta's Banner\r\n#m106030200# - Violetta's Portrait\r\n#m106030210# - Violetta's Statue

0.msg: Are you from the grant-your-wish foundation?

2.msg: Yay! I knew you were it. Please help me! I am #bAnne Nah#k, the 13th president of the princess's fan club. I'm a longtime fan of hers. I know I failed to make her laugh, but I'm honored just to be in her presence.

3.msg: The thing is, I can't go back just yet. I want more memories of this once-in-a-lifetime event. Can you help me? Please?

yes.0: They say there are three symbols of Princess Violetta in this castle. I want to go see them myself, but I have a terrible sense of direction. Could you take pictures of them for me?\r#rTip. Double-click the #t2432656# in your Use inventory to take a photo.#k \r\n

no.0: I'm sorry if you're busy. I guess I'll have to ask my older sister. Do you know her? Her name is Elshwa.

1.0: Did you get all the photos? I hope they're all in focus...

yes.0: These are incredible! So elegant and beautiful, just like the princess. I mean, they're not as great as her... how could they be? I'm sorry to ask but can you take a picture of he-wait, where are you going?!

default.0: They are at these three locations: #b#m106030000##k, #b#m106030200##k, #b#m106030210##k.
